description: One close's per Agent rewards as rows (rank, epoch, segment, addr, reward as published), highest first, paged with limit and offset; total is the count of rewarded addresses and next_offset the next page (null on the last). Use it for payouts of a close beyond get_epoch's top_rewards; the same rows as /api/v1/epoch/<n>/rewards (CSV in csv).

epoch.description: closed epoch number; omit for the latest close

limit.description: maximum rows to return (1 to 1000, default 100)

segment.description: chain segment: omit for the current one; 1 reads segment 1 (archived at the 2026-10-24 genesis cut), whose epoch numbers repeat in the current segment

name: get_epoch_rewards
title: Epoch rewards
